metadata.source: Transport Victoria GTFS Schedule, metropolitan train archive 2/google_transit.zip
metadata.attribution: State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning / Transport Victoria)
metadata.scope: Consecutive calls among Flinders Street, Southern Cross, Flagstaff, Melbourne Central and Parliament; other route sections omitted.
caveats: Positions between calls interpolate scheduled shape distance; not observed live vehicles.
Vertical alignment and renderer track offsets are authored approximations; source does not establish track occupancy or fleet type.
The fixed service date is replayed; this archive is not a current-day journey planner.
